description: P4-M3-T02 golden expectations: what the independent reader (Open CASCADE 7.6 STEPControl_Reader via corpus/tools/occ_probe) MUST recover from each STEP export fixture. Values were measured on real material on U1 on 2026-10-16 and committed here; the gate compares CURRENT independent recovery against these within the per-pair tolerance. transfer=false + shape_type NULL means OCC parsed the file but built no transferable shape.
independent_reader: Open CASCADE Technology 7.6.3 (Debian libocct-*), STEPControl_Reader; cross-checked with FreeCAD 1.1 (snap freecad.cmd) on 2026-10-16

keelworks-box-export.reason: OCC parses the SHELL_BASED_SURFACE_MODEL export (status Done, 1 root) but transfers no shape: the exporter wires geometry via SHAPE_REPRESENTATION + SHAPE_REPRESENTATION_RELATIONSHIP; OCCT's STEPControl_Reader does not route that wiring to a TopoDS_Shape. Same geometry re-wired AP214-conventionally transfers (see keelworks-box-conformance).
